videoUrls.title: YouTube Video URLs
videoUrls.description: One or more YouTube video URLs to generate views for.

viewsPerVideo.title: Views per Video
viewsPerVideo.description: Number of viewing sessions to execute for each specified video URL.

deviceType.title: Device Emulation Type
deviceType.description: Select device category to emulate or distribute traffic across.

customDevice.title: Specific Device (When Device Type = Custom)
customDevice.description: Choose a specific device profile to use for all viewing sessions.

watchDurationMin.title: Min Watch Duration (Seconds)
watchDurationMin.description: Minimum dwell time in seconds to watch the video before ending session.

watchDurationMax.title: Max Watch Duration (Seconds)
watchDurationMax.description: Maximum dwell time in seconds to watch the video before ending session. Duration will be randomly chosen between Min and Max.

playbackQuality.title: Playback Quality
playbackQuality.description: Target video quality resolution. Lower qualities save significant proxy bandwidth and CPU memory.

muteAudio.title: Mute Audio
muteAudio.description: Mute video audio during playback to avoid sound and satisfy autoplay policies.

enableInteractions.title: Simulate Human Micro-Interactions
enableInteractions.description: Randomly perform subtle cursor/touch movements, mini-scrolls, and viewport changes to emulate realistic user behavior.

enableAdvancedFingerprinting.title: Enable Advanced Fingerprinting Evasion
enableAdvancedFingerprinting.description: Spoofs Canvas, WebGL vendor/renderer, AudioContext dynamics, hardware concurrency, and client hints to match each simulated device.

browserPerProxy.title: Browser per Proxy / Session Isolation
browserPerProxy.description: Launches a dedicated fresh browser instance per proxy and viewing session, eliminating cross-session cookie, socket, and cache leakage.

maxConcurrency.title: Max Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of concurrent browser instances running simultaneously.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy configuration for rotating IP addresses between runs and avoiding rate limits.
